, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced and implicitly relied on an incorrect Wikipedia entry showing Charles Saunders’s birth year as 1924 (instead of the correct 1904). This erroneous data, if accepted, would make it appear that the Love in Pawn director was born later than Fernando Fernán Gómez (1921), leading to the wrong conclusion.
